about_the_game:
Unlock access to the Skull Bucket bundle and get the job done with this unique selection of six new helmets.
Land on your feet with the 101st Airborne 506th PIR Paratrooper M1 helmet for the US faction, retain your camouflage with the Paratrooper M38 Fallschirmjäger Helmet for the German forces, and with winter around the corner, keep your soldier warm with the Soviet M36 Budenovka Winter Cap.

The Skull Bucket Bundle includes two new helmets for each faction:

US Forces –
101st Airborne 506th PIR Paratrooper M1
29th Infantry Division M1

German Forces –
Paratrooper M38 Fallschirmjäger Helmet
M35 Double Decal Police Helmet

Soviet Faction –
1941 Model Blockaded Leningrad Helmet
M36 Budenovka Winter Cap
